edition: David McCalman Turpie, The Old Testament in the New (1868)
pdf_page_numbering: One-based PDF page numbers; printed page = PDF page minus 38 where numbered.
transcription_scope: Printed and normalized NT, LXX, and Hebrew reference headings and table metadata. Later displayed headings and alternatives are recorded separately. No Greek, Hebrew, or English quotation wording has been transcribed.
